topic: Decide the agenda structure for weekly standups

scenario.topic: Decide the agenda structure for weekly standups
scenario.opening_question: How should we structure our weekly standups to balance efficiency and team alignment?

options.name: Round-Robin Status Updates with Time Limits
options.upside: Ensures everyone speaks equally and concisely
options.tradeoff: May limit deeper discussion on complex blockers
options.concern: Some issues might be rushed or overlooked
options.best_for: teams prioritizing equal participation and time discipline

options.name: Priority Blocker Discussion Followed by Quick Updates
options.upside: Focuses on removing obstacles early in the meeting
options.tradeoff: Less time for general status updates
options.concern: Minor updates might feel rushed or skipped
options.best_for: teams needing to quickly resolve issues

options.name: Themed Weekly Focus with Rotating Lead Speaker
options.upside: Encourages deeper engagement on important topics
options.tradeoff: Less frequent coverage of all routine updates
options.concern: Some team members may feel less heard on non-theme weeks

options.name: Asynchronous Pre-Meeting Updates with Live Q&A
options.upside: Saves live time for clarifications and discussion
options.tradeoff: Requires discipline to submit updates beforehand
options.concern: Risk of disengagement if pre-meeting updates are ignored
options.best_for: teams comfortable with async communication and brief live sync

shared_context: Standups are limited to 15 minutes max each week
The goal is to keep everyone informed and unblock progress

personas.name: Rosa
personas.background: Rosa values efficient use of live meeting time and prefers asynchronous updates to reduce meeting length and focus on clarifications.
personas.private_goal: She wants a meeting structure that saves live time for essential Q&A and avoids lengthy status updates.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference

object to the main rival option with a concrete concern

personas.name: Yuki
personas.background: Yuki prefers a concise meeting format that minimizes disruptions and values asynchronous communication to keep meetings brief and focused.
personas.private_goal: She wants a structure that emphasizes information efficiency and limits live meeting duration.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference

personas.name: Quinn
personas.background: Quinn prioritizes quickly resolving blockers early in the meeting to keep the team moving forward and reduce obstacles.
personas.private_goal: He wants a meeting agenda that focuses on problem solving while still allowing some time for updates.
